_comment: Cross-language equivalence fixture (Skeptic Minor 2 on PR #730): exercised by BOTH hooks/tests/test-overreach-detector.js and bin/tests/test_ds_measure_conductor_tool_calls.py, asserting byte-identical output from the JS detector (hooks/lib/overreach-detector.js) and the Python calibrator (bin/ds-measure-conductor-tool-calls) against the SAME transcript. Encodes the Critical-2 regression directly: three investigation calls (Read, Bash cat, Read) occur BEFORE any subagent spawn, each with its own (non-Agent) tool_result. Under the pre-fix bug (the post-spawn spot-check window reset on ANY tool_result, not just an Agent-tool's own result), the second and third calls were incorrectly whitelisted as 'post-spawn spot-checks' even though no spawn had happened yet - reducing conductor_tool_calls from the correct 3 to 1 and whitelisted_reads_excluded from the correct 0 to 2 for that segment. The fixture then adds a real Agent spawn (tool_use id agent-1) and its own tool_result (opens the window correctly), followed by two Read calls inside the 2-call spot-check window (correctly whitelisted) and a third Read call outside it (correctly counted), each separated by a NON-Agent tool_result that must not touch the window.
